title: add-rag-step-replayer-cli-quickstart
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: developers asked for a compact reproducible session capture and deterministic stepwise replay tool to debug RAG agents at the edge where reproducing live incidents is costly. Motivation: provide a lightweight CLI quickstart that captures tool calls, prompt inputs/outputs, and intermediate KV cache snapshots in a compressed, schema-vetted fixture format, plus a playback runner that can step through a session with assertions and telemetry hooks. This PR adds an end-to-end example, docs, tests, CI, and minimal telemetry schema. Checklist: [x] quickstart README with hands-on steps and expected outputs [x] CLI capture binary + small Go shim for portability [x] JSONL session fixture format and schema validation [x] stepwise replayer with step assertions and failure reporting [x] CI workflow that runs smoke capture+replay on push [x] sample fixtures and test harness for flaky-protection. Commits summary: "init: scaffold rag-step-replayer quickstart" adds README, CLI scaffold, and basic examples; "feat: implement capture format and basic recorder" implements session capture and compression; "feat: add replayer with step assertions and telemetry hooks" implements playback runner and assertion engine; "test: add fixtures and CI smoke tests" adds sample sessions and CI workflow; "chore: docs polish and examples" updates README and code comments. Changed areas: quickstarts/rag-step-replayer/README.md — new quickstart guide with step-by-step capture/playback instructions and troubleshooting notes; quickstarts/rag-step-replayer/cli/main.go — compact Go CLI (~420 LOC) implementing capture and playback modes with flags for output path, redact-level, and verboseness; quickstarts/rag-step-replayer/fixtures/sample_session.jsonl — sample captured session representing a 3-tool run; quickstarts/rag-step-replayer/tests/replayer_integration_test.go — integration test that runs capture->replay in CI with assertions on outputs; docs/quickstarts/rag-playbooks.md — reference entry linking the new quickstart and describing the fixture schema; .github/workflows/rag-step-replayer-ci.yml — CI workflow to build and run the integration smoke tests; telemetry/schemas/step_replay.yaml — telemetry event schema for capture/replay lifecycle. Review conversation: "Ethan Park: Nice work, this will help a lot during incident investigations. Please make the fixture size smaller and add an option to snapshot only tool calls (skip token-level KV)." "Maya Chen: Addressed — added --snapshot-mode flag (tools|full) and updated fixtures to include a compact sample. Reduced sample session to 3KB gzipped in tests." "Luis Gómez: Can we emit a minimal telemetry event for each replay step so SREs can trace failing assertions?" "Maya Chen: Added telemetry schema and optional telemetry hooks; default off for quickstart. Updated docs to show how to enable." "Sofia Patel: LGTM after small docs nit (clarify redact-level behavior)." "Maya Chen: Fixed wording and added example to README." CI summary: initial run failed lint on missing gofmt, author fixed and re-ran, subsequent run passed all checks including build, unit tests, and integration smoke test (matrix: go1.20, ubuntu-latest). Merge outcome: merged via squash after approvals from Ethan and Sofia. Notes: keeps quickstart self-contained, minimal external deps, avoids shipping production runtime code; quickstart intended as a reference for teams to adapt to Dedicated/Private deployments. How to use: install the CLI, run `replayer capture --out=session.jsonl` against a local dev agent, then `replayer replay --in=session.jsonl --assertions=examples/asserts.yaml` to step through. Support and follow-ups: recommend follow-up ENG tasks to add a Python shim for cross-language capture and a small GA telemetry dashboard (see ENG-4992).
